double-ended-saddle-search/lj38.caption: Dolan-Moré profile for Minimum mode on LJ38 double-ended saddle. The curve is the fraction of starts whose cost is at most tau times the best finite cost in this family. Tau is 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16. An unsolved start stays in the denominator and does not cross a finite tau. Dolan, E. D. and Moré, J. J., Math. Program. 91:201-213, 2002.
